newsHighlights.title: In search of Bruce Lee: Legacy beyond the screen
newsHighlights.summary: Fans and travellers are rediscovering Bruce Lee, whose legacy extends far beyond the screen and keeps drawing visitors to Hong Kong.
newsHighlights.translation: 追寻李小龙：超越银幕的传奇——影迷与旅行者正在重新认识李小龙，他的影响力远超银幕，至今仍吸引着游客前往香港。

newsHighlights.title: Belt and Road Documentary Forum bridges Xinjiang's perspectives to intl screens
newsHighlights.summary: The Belt and Road Documentary Forum brings Xinjiang's perspectives to international screens and helps global audiences understand the region.
newsHighlights.translation: 一带一路纪录片论坛将新疆的视角带上国际银幕，帮助全球观众了解这一地区。

newsHighlights.title: Pakistani minister: China's space mission shows its inclusive approach
newsHighlights.summary: Pakistan's Muhammad Zeeshan Ali has become the first foreign astronaut to visit China's space station, showing an inclusive approach to cooperation.
newsHighlights.translation: 巴基斯坦的穆罕默德·泽尚·阿里成为首位到访中国空间站的外国航天员，体现了包容合作的态度。

newsHighlights.title: The past, present and future of thrift shame in Europe
newsHighlights.summary: Thrift shame in Europe reflects changing cultural attitudes towards saving, spending and the meaning of a good life.
newsHighlights.translation: 欧洲的“节俭羞耻”现象反映了人们对储蓄、消费与美好生活定义的文化观念变迁。

newsHighlights.title: Mayors in global dialogue share experiences and outcomes
newsHighlights.summary: Mayors from around the world joined a global dialogue to share experiences on tourism, culture and urban development.
newsHighlights.translation: 来自世界各地的市长参与全球对话，分享旅游、文化与城市发展的经验与成果。

quote.quote: The world is a book and those who do not travel read only one page.
quote.author: Saint Augustine
quote.translation: 世界是一本书，不旅行的人只读了其中一页。
quote.explanation: 这句话把世界比作一本大书，把旅行比作阅读。它告诉我们：只待在一个地方，就像只读了书的第一页；走出去、接触不同的文化与人群，才能真正了解这个世界的丰富与多元。

vocabulary.definition: 遗产；遗赠；（名人留下的）影响、精神财富
vocabulary.example: Bruce Lee's legacy reaches far beyond the screen.
vocabulary.translation: 李小龙留下的影响远远超越了银幕。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻标题 "In search of Bruce Lee: Legacy beyond the screen"，指李小龙留下的文化影响与精神遗产。

vocabulary.example: The Belt and Road Documentary Forum brought Xinjiang's stories to international screens.
vocabulary.translation: 一带一路纪录片论坛把新疆的故事带上了国际银幕。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 "Belt and Road Documentary Forum bridges Xinjiang's perspectives to intl screens"，指纪录片这一文化传播载体。

vocabulary.definition: 视角；观点；看待事物的方式
vocabulary.example: The forum bridges Xinjiang's perspectives to international screens.
vocabulary.translation: 该论坛将新疆的视角连接到国际银幕上。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出现在 "Belt and Road Documentary Forum bridges Xinjiang's perspectives" 中，强调文化交流中的视角互鉴。

vocabulary.example: Documentaries can bridge the gap between different cultures.
vocabulary.translation: 纪录片可以弥合不同文化之间的鸿沟。
vocabulary.newsContext: 源自 "bridges Xinjiang's perspectives to intl screens"，此处 bridge 作动词，意为“连接、沟通”。

vocabulary.definition: 包容的；包含在内的；开放的
vocabulary.example: China's space mission shows its inclusive approach to international cooperation.
vocabulary.translation: 中国的航天任务体现了其国际合作中的包容态度。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自 "Pakistani minister: China's space mission shows its inclusive approach"，形容开放包容的合作方式。

vocabulary.example: Mayors from around the world joined a global dialogue on culture and tourism.
vocabulary.translation: 来自世界各地的市长参与了一场关于文化与旅游的全球对话。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 "Mayors in global dialogue share experiences and outcomes"，指城市之间的国际交流对话。

vocabulary.example: The technology was developed for speech restoration in patients.
vocabulary.translation: 这项技术是为帮助患者恢复语言能力而研发的。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自 "China develops Mandarin BCI for speech restoration"，指恢复患者的语言交流能力。

vocabulary.example: Thrift shame in Europe reflects changing cultural attitudes towards money.
vocabulary.translation: 欧洲的“节俭羞耻”反映了人们对金钱的文化观念变化。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 "The past, present and future of thrift shame in Europe"，讨论欧洲社会对节俭的文化态度。

vocabulary.example: A migrant boat was rescued off Spain's El Hierro island.
vocabulary.translation: 一艘移民船在西班牙耶罗岛附近海域获救。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自 "At least eight dead after migrant boat rescued off Spain's El Hierro island"，与跨境旅行、迁徙话题相关。

vocabulary.definition: 遗产（尤指文化遗产、传统）
vocabulary.example: Travellers come to see the city's cultural heritage for themselves.
vocabulary.translation: 旅行者前来亲眼目睹这座城市的文化遗产。
vocabulary.newsContext: 与今日李小龙文化、一带一路纪录片论坛等文化遗产传播主题相关，是报道中反复出现的核心概念。

pattern.pattern: …, marking the first/only … (……，标志着首次/唯一的……)
pattern.example: Chinese researchers have enabled a patient to communicate through thought alone, marking the country's first clinical trial of a wireless, invasive Mandarin brain-computer interface.
pattern.translation: 中国研究人员使一名患者仅凭意念即可交流，标志着该国首次开展无线侵入式中文脑机接口临床试验。
pattern.usage: 该句型用现在分词短语作结果或伴随状语，补充说明主句事件的意义、里程碑或后果。常见于新闻导语中，用于突出“首次”“创纪录”等亮点。可替换为 marking a milestone in… / marking the beginning of… 等。

grammar.title: 现在完成时在新闻导语中的运用（Present Perfect in News Leads）
grammar.explanation: 英语新闻导语常用现在完成时（have/has + 过去分词），强调已经发生且对现在仍有影响的事件，突出新闻的“新近性”。常与 already, just, yet, so far, recently 等时间副词连用。当主语是第三人称单数时用 has + 过去分词。注意：若新闻中明确给出过去时间（如 yesterday、last week），则改用一般过去时。
examples: The successful launch of Shenzhou XXIV has captured global attention.
Pakistan's Muhammad Zeeshan Ali has become the first foreign astronaut aboard China's Tiangong space station.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第三个音节 -men- 上，读作 /ˌdɒkjuˈmentəri/。前两个音节 /ˌdɒkju/ 要读得轻快、含糊，结尾的 -ary 弱读为 /əri/ 而不是 /eəri/。注意 doc-u-men-ta-ry 共五个音节，不要省略音节读成 "doc-men-try"。
examples: The Belt and Road Documentary Forum was held in Xinjiang.
She has directed a documentary about Bruce Lee's legacy.

reading.title: When Cultures Meet: Stories That Travel Across Borders
reading.content: Cultural exchange is having a busy week. In southern China, fans are searching for Bruce Lee, whose legacy reaches far beyond the screen. His films turned kung fu into a global language and still draw travellers to Hong Kong. Meanwhile, the Belt and Road Documentary Forum in Xinjiang is bringing local perspectives to international screens, helping foreign audiences see a region they rarely visit. The story even extends into space: Pakistani astronaut Muhammad Zeeshan Ali has become the first foreign astronaut aboard China's Tiangong station, showing how inclusive cooperation can open new routes — even beyond Earth. For travellers, the lesson is simple. Every journey begins with a story, and every story invites us to look at the world from a different perspective. When cultures meet, the map grows larger for everyone.
reading.translation: 文化交流本周格外热闹。在中国南方，人们正追寻李小龙的足迹，他的影响远远超越银幕。他把功夫变成了一门世界语言，至今仍吸引着旅行者前往香港。与此同时，在新疆举办的一带一路纪录片论坛把当地视角带上国际银幕，帮助外国观众了解一个他们很少踏足的地区。这个故事甚至延伸到了太空：巴基斯坦航天员穆罕默德·泽尚·阿里成为首位登上中国天宫空间站的外国航天员，展现了包容合作如何开启新的通道——哪怕是在地球之外。对旅行者的启示很简单：每段旅程都始于一个故事，而每个故事都邀请我们从不同的视角看世界。当文化相遇，每个人的世界版图都会变得更大。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 2026 年 11 月 28 日 ChinaDaily 真实新闻素材改写，包括《追寻李小龙：超越银幕的传奇》《一带一路纪录片论坛将新疆视角带上国际银幕》以及《巴基斯坦部长：中国航天任务体现包容态度》等报道，语言难度经简化处理，适合中级英语学习者阅读。
